pretreatments.description: Grinding using a grinder (Bosch MKM6003, Iran)

Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) pretreatment: presoaking in 8% wt. sodium hydroxide solution (95 g) at room temperature for 10 min with stirring, followed by heating to 100 °C for 10 min in an oil bath, cooling in an ice bath, centrifugation, washing with distilled water, freezing, and freeze-drying.

Liquid hot water (LHW) pretreatment: presoaking in distilled water instead of alkaline solution, heating to 100 °C for 10 min in an oil bath, cooling in an ice bath, centrifugation, washing with distilled water, freezing, and freeze-drying.
Biological pretreatment: aerobic digestion using the aerobic sludge at 37 °C and 90 rpm in a shaker incubator for 10 days.
Ultrasonic pretreatment: incubation in an ultrasonic bath at 40 KHz frequency for 30 min at 40 °C.
